feeds.title: Canadian Psychological Association
feeds.description: The Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) is the largest national association for the science, practice, and education of psychology in Canada. We have been championing Canadian psychological science, practice and education since 1939.

feeds.title: Dr. Patrick Keelan Blog
feeds.description: A blog with offerings and advice on improving your life and well being through psychology. Written by Calgary psychologist, Dr. Patrick Keelan.

feeds.title: The Family Psychology Place Blog
feeds.description: The Family Psychology Place is the largest private psychology clinic in western Canada. We have many psychologists, most full-time and some part-time. We also have MSWs, speech language therapists, occupational therapists, and teachers to round out our team.

feeds.title: Maria Schmid & Partners Blog
feeds.description: We are a dedicated group of independent psychologists & practitioners providing support for individuals, couples and families in Calgary since 2008.

feeds.title: Assured Psychology Blog
feeds.description: We are passionate about helping adults and older teens, individuals and couples improve their lives and their relationships. It is our values of compassion, competence, and warmth that drive us and our work at Assured Psychology. We try to create a place of healing and growth for all our clients.

feeds.title: Downtown Psychology Clinic Blog
feeds.description: At the Downtown Psychology Clinic, we are focused on providing evidence-based and effective psychological treatment, such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT). We aim to provide clients with a safe and comfortable environment in which to help them discuss, explore and resolve their current difficulties to work towards a happier and more productive life.

feeds.title: Fenwick Psychology and Wellness Associates Blog
feeds.description: Life is full of twists and turns. Fenwick Psychology and Wellness Associates are here to help you navigate them. Our passionate and experienced clinicians have been offering therapy, assessment and counseling services in Halifax for over 20 years.

feeds.title: Essence Psychology Blog
feeds.description: I am Aliya. I believe each person is the absolute expert in their own life - you live it, experience it, and feel it. When working together, I aim to provide you with a different perspective and wherever possible to build awareness around the root cause of your struggle.

feeds.title: Toronto Psychology Clinic Blog
feeds.description: Our blog covers topics such as mental health, productivity, research developments in psychotherapy. We are a team of experienced psychologists and PhD and MA - level clinical associates providing psychology services using evidence-based practices.

feeds.title: Clinic Psychology Blog
feeds.description: We, at Clinic Psychology Manitoba, are a group of psychologists in Winnipeg, dedicated to working with clients in improving their mental health. We specialize in evidence-based treatment strategies that primarily include cognitive behaviour therapy (CBT), and mindfulness based approaches.

feeds.title: New Leaf Psychology Centre Blog
feeds.description: New Leaf Psychology Centre is committed to providing a place where you and your family can feel comfortable and understood. We specialize in individual therapy, group therapy, couples and family therapy, psychology assessments, career counseling, dietetic services, rehabilitation & more.

feeds.title: Bhatia Psychology Group Blog
feeds.description: Bhatia Psychology Group has a collection of the latest articles concerning mental health support & taking better care of yourself mentally. At Bhatia Psychology Group, we give you the tools you need to deal with the challenges that life throws your way. Through effective treatment plans, we empower you to become the best version of yourself.

feeds.title: KV Psychology & Wellness Clinic Blog
feeds.description: KV Psychology & Wellness Clinic offers a full range of psychological services for children, youth, adults, and families. We have a variety of professionals - Licensed Psychologists, Registered Social Workers and Licensed Counselling Therapists.

feeds.title: Family Psychology Centre Blog
feeds.description: A full-service psychology practice for children, adolescents, adults, and families.

feeds.title: Little Oaks Psychology Blog
feeds.description: Little Oaks Psychology offers families and clients clarity and direction through psychoeducational & psychological assessment, counselling, & consultation.We specialize in dual-diagnosis and differential diagnosis for psychological concerns.

feeds.title: Zen Psychology Blog
feeds.description: My name is Jaime Rasmussen. I am a registered provisional psychologist and a member of the College of Alberta Psychologists and the Psychologists' Association of Alberta. My approach is integrative and evidence-based and combines mindfulness, cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT), and acceptance-commitment therapy (ACT) to deepen insight, awareness, vitality, flexibility, and choice.

feeds.title: Approach Psychology Blog
feeds.description: Approach Psychological Services is a community focused counselling centre for families, children, couples, adolescents, and individuals. We also provide performance and sport psychology services.

feeds.title: Pinnacle Psych Blog
feeds.description: At Pinnacle Psych, we specialize in the usual suspects of depression and anxiety, as well as ADHD, LD, OCD, Tourette's Syndrome & Tic Disorders, psychoeducational assessments, and trauma (including in first-responder populations).

feeds.title: Evolution Psychology Center Blog
feeds.description: We are interested in your overall health; emotional, psychological, and physical. As such, we offer a variety of wellness services for both your body and mind. Whatever your struggle, we can help you overcome in a comfortable and supportive setting. No matter the challenge, Evolution Psychology Center can help.

feeds.title: Insight Psychology on Norfolk Blog
feeds.description: Insight Psychology on Norfolk is a team of psychologists, psychological associates, and allied mental health professionals who work collaboratively to provide high-quality, evidence-based assessment, treatment, and consultation services for children, adolescents, young adults, and families in Guelph and the surrounding area.

feeds.title: Dr. Brad Bowins
feeds.description: A blog for informed change by Dr. Brad Bowins, a psychiatrist, researcher, and founder of the Centre For Theoretical Research In Psychiatry & Clinical Psychology.

feeds.title: Advanced Psychology Services
feeds.description: Welcome to child development and parenting blog by psychologist Dr. Tali Shenfield. In this blog, you will find hundreds of articles and resources on various topics incl. parenting of special needs children.

feeds.title: Nancy Morris Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nancy Morris, a business psychologist for over 25 years. I've helped small to medium-sized businesses and individuals master thinking, because when you master thinking, you master results, productivity, profits, performance, goals, and more.

feeds.title: Hexagon Psychology Blog
feeds.description: Blogging about mental wellness for children and adults to encourage flourishing. Hexagon Psychology provides a wide-range of online or in-person psychological assessment and counselling services to children, youth, and adults in Airdrie, Alberta.

feeds.title: SJ Psychology Centre Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to provide best practice psychological services to children and adults with mental health difficulties.

feeds.title: Dochas Psychological Services Inc. Blog
feeds.description: At Dochas Psychological we offer counselling and mental health services for adolescents, veterans, and adults in the Stony Plain, Spruce Grove, Parkland County, and Edmonton areas. We are committed to making you feel safer in an unpredictable world by empowering you to trust what your mind, body, and emotions tell you.

feeds.title: McAtee Psychology Blog
feeds.description: We provide professional counselling and assessment services for a wide range of issues. Our areas of expertise include therapy for children, teens, and relationship issues (family + couples therapy).
